Everything lives under config/gtit/: signin/daily_signin.json for rewards and tiers, signin/online_time_config.json for time tiers, lottery/lottery.json for pools, mail/blessing_config.json for festivals and birthdays, gift_config.json for the starter gift, and trade/trades/tab_<id>.json plus trade/pages.json for the shop itself.

Old locations are migrated automatically with .bak copies left behind. Hand-editing is supported — pair it with the reload commands from the previous quest.
